description: A generated C# class with `Up` and `Down` methods that moves the database schema one step forward or back.
The `ModelSnapshot.cs` file in source control that `migrations add` compares the current model against to generate the next migration.
The table where EF Core records applied migrations, so each environment runs only the ones it is missing.
A single executable built with `dotnet ef migrations bundle` that applies migrations without the SDK or the source code.
A SQL script from `dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent` that checks the history table and applies only missing migrations.
The database-wide lock EF Core 9 and later take while applying migrations, so concurrent runs cannot corrupt the schema.
The migration operation that runs hand-written SQL, used for data backfills that must run once with a schema change.
